Perfect with COVID and flu vaccine.
Visiting at home and assessment been a great help.
I hate to trouble him ,but he is patient and caring. Jean appreciates it.The nurse was great help. Super practice overall.
We are lucky in Dorset.

2026 ....continued a year later
